c1.text: Pier four. A hairline crack, noted in 2020. The strain kept climbing. The alerts went unanswered.

c2.text: This bridge is a simulation. Genoa, Morbi and Pittsburgh were not. The warnings were there. Nobody connected them.

s0.title: InfraTwin-Live
s0.text: InfraTwin-Live connects the warnings. It watches structures live, inspects them with AI, and plans what to do next.

s1.title: A live digital twin of the network
s1.text: Every structure is a 3D twin built from its members, coloured by live sensor health.

s2a.title: Real bridge. Real data.
s2a.text: Railway bridge KW51 in Belgium: fifteen months of real monitoring data. The twin removes temperature and frost effects, and watches what is left.

s2b.text: When the bridge was strengthened in 2019, the twin flags the stiffness change, and Muse Spark explains it like an engineer.

s3a.title: An AI inspector
s3a.text: A real inspection photo. Muse Spark reads it like a senior inspector, and SAM 3.1 makes every defect pixel-accurate.

s3b.text: Defects, severity, the member they sit on, and a written assessment, in about twenty seconds.

s4a.title: Seeing around obstacles
s4a.text: This crack hides behind a drainage pipe. Flying straight at it, a drone sees only thirty percent.

s4b.text: Muse Wonder tests camera angles on the twin, and plans a safe flight that sees all of it.

s5a.title: Two years from now
s5a.text: What if nobody acts? Muse Spark reasons about the damage, and Muse Image shows it.

s5c.text: Two years: rust and efflorescence. The steel is corroding.

s6a.title: Hands-free in the field
s6a.text: On site, the inspector just speaks.

s6b.text: Transcribed, understood, and acted on: a field note, and a new drone mission.

s7.title: InfraTwin-Live
s7.text: Monitor, inspect, act. From a drifting sensor to a drone flight, in minutes. So the next warning gets connected.

command.text: Note a shear crack on Pier 4, and plan a drone re-scan around the drainage pipe.

s8.title: Every structure, one screen
s8.text: Zoom out: every bridge, tunnel and dam on one live globe. What is failing, what is being repaired, and where.
